title: NeurIPS checklist: transparency and uncertainty
sourceSection: Claims, Limitations, Experimental Result Reproducibility, Experimental Statistical Significance
scope: Checklist applicability depends on the NeurIPS edition and track
summary: Explain limitations, reproducibility, and the variation represented by error bars. Describe the procedure and assumptions, distinguishing standard deviation, standard error and intervals.
interpretation: The demo reports sample standard deviation over training runs with fixed data and does not turn ten seeds into a population interval.
limitations: The checklist does not require ten seeds. Recheck edition and track rules before submission; a completed checklist does not certify scientific validity.
